rules.rule: On a synthetic AI panel, copy over ~22 words scored 0.42 points lower on a 1-10 appeal scale (90% CI -0.73 to -0.08; 7 variants, 5 concepts); fragile finding.
rules.advice: Lean toward keeping copy under about 22 words. Treat this as a tentative signal, since the evidence is fragile and comes from AI personas. Check it with real audiences before making it a firm rule.
